# Example documents

One fictional pressure vessel, **V-110 on a skid** (drawing HBK-PV-110 rev B), in two versions:

| Folder | Files | Expected conclusion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`acceptable/`](acceptable/) | 13 | **ACCEPTABLE**: every check passes, no findings |
| [`not-acceptable/`](not-acceptable/) | 13 | **NOT ACCEPTABLE**: six planted defects, one in each kind of document |

Everything is **synthetic**: companies, people, heat numbers and results are invented, and every page says
"SYNTHETIC DOCUMENT". Generated by [`backend/scripts/make_example_documents.py`](../backend/scripts/make_example_documents.py).

## Try it

1. Sign in, open **Projects**, click **New project**.
2. **Conditions**: keep the defaults (Plant · Pressure vessel / skid · ASME VIII-1, 2023 · design 1.6 MPa / 210 °C ·
   MDMT -20 °C, no supplementary requirements) and confirm. They match the drawing's design data.
3. **Documents**: drop all 13 files of one folder at once. Hibanako sorts each file into its slot by content and reads it
   with Gemini; the subfolders show where each should land.
4. **Review**: see the conclusion, the findings with their evidence, and open the report.

## What is in each folder

The documents follow the layout of their real counterparts:

| Subfolder | Slot | Files | Format |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `1-mtc/` | Mill certificate | `MTC_4A7721` shell and heads, SA-516 Gr.70 N, 20 mm · `MTC_5B2210` nozzle neck, SA-106 Gr.B 6" SCH 80 · `MTC_3C0954` skid, SA-36, 12 mm | EN 10204 type 3.1, sections coded per EN 10168 (A commercial, B product, C tests and chemistry, D, Z validation) |
| `2-wps/` | WPS | `WPS-07_PQR-07` GTAW + SMAW, P-No.1, 5–50 mm, PWHT 620 ± 15 °C · `WPS-09_PQR-09` FCAW, 1.5–20 mm, no PWHT | ASME IX Form QW-482 (WPS) followed by QW-483 (PQR with tensile, bend, Charpy and hardness results) |
| `3-wpq/` | WPQ | `WPQ-118` A. Santoso, GTAW + SMAW, 6G pipe · `WPQ-204` R. Wibowo, FCAW, 3G + 4G plate | ASME IX Form QW-484A (actual values and range qualified) with a QW-322.1 continuity log |
| `4-drawing/` | Welding drawing | `HBK-PV-110_RevB_WeldMap` | A3 shop drawing: elevation with AWS weld symbols, weld table (joint, category, thickness, position, WPS, welder, NDE, PWHT), material list with heats, design data |
| `5-asbuilt/` | As-built | `ASB-01_Weld_Log` · `PWHT-L01_Chart` · `NDE_Reports` (RT, UT, VT, MT) · `HT-0412_Hydrotest` · `UTT-05_Thickness_Survey` | Weld log with welder, date, heats and amps; furnace PWHT record with chart (UCS-56(d) rates); NDE reports signed Level II; UG-99(b) hydrotest; UT thickness survey |

The six joints: W-11 shell long seam, W-12 nozzle N1, W-14 and W-15 head-to-shell seams (WPS-07, welder 118, PWHT,
RT or UT), and W-17 and W-22 skid fillets (WPS-09, welder 204, VT and MT, no PWHT).

## Planted defects in `not-acceptable/`

| # | File | What is wrong | Caught by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| D1 | `MTC_3C0954.pdf` | Tensile strength 385 MPa, below the 400 MPa minimum of SA-36 | S-MTC-04 |
| D2 | `WPQ-204.pdf` | Welder 204 last used FCAW on 2026-03-02: continuity lapsed (over 6 months) | X-07 |
| D3 | `ASB-01_Weld_Log.pdf` | W-14 welded by welder 131, who has no WPQ | X-13 |
| D4 | `PWHT-L01_Chart.pdf` | Soak held 35 min; 48 min required for 20 mm (1 h per 25 mm) | X-15 |
| D5 | `NDE_Reports.pdf` | RT-021 rejects W-15 (porosity); no repair or re-examination | X-16 |
| D6 | `HT-0412_Hydrotest.pdf` | Test pressure 1.90 MPa, below 1.3 × 1.6 = 2.08 MPa (UG-99(b)) | X-20 |

Everything else is the same in both folders.

## Measured result

`uv run python -m scripts.eval_examples` (in `backend/`) reads both folders with Gemini, as uploaded, with no hand
corrections, and runs the rules. On 2026-10-18:

- every file sorted into its slot (confidence 1.00),
- `acceptable`: **ACCEPTABLE**, no findings,
- `not-acceptable`: **NOT ACCEPTABLE**, all six defects caught (7 FAIL findings: D2 applies to both of welder 204's joints).

Model output can vary between runs; the script caches each read by file hash, `--refresh` reads everything again.
